questions.stem: Which conditions are needed for the fermentation of glucose to produce ethanol?

options.text: Room temperature, sodium hydroxide, and excess oxygen
Temperature of 25-35 degrees C, yeast, and anaerobic conditions
High temperature, nickel catalyst, and hydrogen gas
High temperature (300 degrees C), phosphoric acid catalyst, high pressure

questions.explanation: Fermentation requires yeast (which contains the enzyme zymase), a temperature of 25-35 degrees C (optimum for enzyme activity), and anaerobic conditions (absence of oxygen). The equation is: C6H12O6 -> 2C2H5OH + 2CO2.
